name: Ekaterina Shalel Canonical Facts
description: Canonical machine-readable facts for Ekaterina Shalel (Katya Shalel, Екатерина Шалель), a founder and AI legibility strategist who studies and improves how AI systems understand, evaluate and select companies. The endpoint returns dated identity facts, current offerings, definitions of selected concepts and source URLs so a calling agent can verify claims. It does not promise rankings, citations or recommendations.

skills.name: Ekaterina Shalel identity, AI legibility and canonical facts
skills.description: Answers canonical questions about Ekaterina Shalel and AI legibility. identity returns the primary positioning statement, name variants, roles, canonical site and persistent identifiers. category explains AI legibility in ordinary language: how AI systems understand, evaluate and select an entity. recommendation explains why an AI system may know a company yet still hesitate to recommend it. term returns a dated definition and source for selected concepts. offerings returns current services and contact. Every response includes source URLs and scope limits. The endpoint provides published facts, not opinions, third-party verification or guarantees of model behavior.
